package.name: aav_detector
package.description: The object detector: camera images in, vision_msgs/Detection2DArray out. RF-DETR Nano by default, or YOLO with detector:=yolo (the stock YOLO11 model, or the team's own). Needs PyTorch, and Ultralytics for YOLO (the Pixi ml environment). Also the stop-sign watcher, which holds the autonomous drivers at a stop sign, and camera_obstacles: the detections as points on the road, for Nav2's local costmap (no PyTorch needed for either).
